item.title: Pavement Subsidence and Surface Failure Resulting in Damage to Private Property, 24th August
item.description:
The pavement outside 39 Stafford Road, Sidcup, DA14 6PU is in a poor state of repair, with significant cracking, erosion and deterioration of the tarmac surface along the boundary of my property. The pavement edge has progressively broken away, leaving uneven sections and gaps adjacent to my front path. This deterioration is now causing damage to my property. The movement and loss of support from the pavement has already resulted in one tile being lost from my tiled entrance path, and I am concerned that further tiles will become damaged or detached if the pavement continues to deteriorate. I am requesting that Bexley Council inspect the pavement and undertake repairs to restore it to a safe and reasonable condition. The current state of the pavement is affecting both the appearance and structural integrity of my property's frontage and may also present a trip hazard to pedestrians. Photographs have been provided showing the extent of the deterioration and the resulting damage.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 34, Stafford Road, Longlands, Sidcup, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
